about.story: I got started building Shopify stores almost by accident — a friend's small business needed an online storefront fast, and once it launched, their sales outpaced what anyone expected from a plain, out-of-the-box theme. That one project turned into a full-time focus on e-commerce. What makes me different is that I don't just make a store look good, I build the whole shopping experience around getting visitors to actually buy: fast product discovery, clear product pages, and checkout flows that don't lose sales at the last step. My mission is to help small and growing brands launch stores that look premium and convert, without needing a big agency budget.
